sentences: The bill would require the ACT Government to hold an inquiry into the law that allowed it to take over Calvary Public Hospital.
The inquiry would be conducted under a new section 75 of the Australian Capital Territory (Self-Government) Act 1988, and a report must be delivered before 30 June 2024.
The requirement to hold the inquiry would expire on 1 July 2025.
changes: Adds a new section 75 to the Australian Capital Territory (Self-Government) Act 1988.
Requires the ACT Government to conduct an inquiry into the Health Infrastructure Enabling Act 2023 (ACT).
Requires the ACT Government to report on the inquiry before 30 June 2024.
Sets the new section to sunset on 1 July 2025.
summary.affected: The ACT Government and people affected by the Calvary Public Hospital acquisition.
